What if you could transform a small local business into a professional online brand using AI? 

Every festive season, thousands of customers search online for homemade sweets, traditional snacks, gift boxes, and authentic local products.

But many talented home-based entrepreneurs and small business owners still depend on WhatsApp messages, phone calls, and word of mouth recommendations to receive orders.

What if we could help them reach more customers by building their own online store?

In this video, I'll demonstrate how to take a traditional homemade sweets business and transform it into an online brand using AI tools.

We'll use a practical example inspired by Paati's Kadai, a traditional sweets and snacks business, and explore the complete process from generating product images to building and launching an e-commerce website.

This is a practical, step-by-step tutorial designed for beginners, small business owners, freelancers, and anyone interested in using AI for real world business applications.

What You'll Learn in This Video

• How to transform an offline business into an online store

• How to plan an e-commerce website using AI

• How to create a brand identity for a traditional local business

• How to generate professional-looking product images using AI

• How to create product listings for sweets and snacks

• How to organize products into an online catalog

• How to design a modern, mobile-friendly shopping website

• How to build an e-commerce website from scratch

• How to prepare your website for real customers

• How to deploy your website and make it live

• How AI can help freelancers offer website-building services to small businesses

Real World Example: Paati's Kadai

Imagine a grandmother preparing delicious homemade sweets and traditional snacks from her own kitchen.

Her products are authentic, her customers love them, and most of her orders arrive through WhatsApp.

But she doesn't have a professional website or an online brand.

In this tutorial, we'll explore how AI can help transform that traditional business into a modern digital storefront.

Our transformation journey:

Offline Sweet Shop → Brand Identity → AI Product Images → Product Catalog → E-Commerce Website → Live Online Store

We'll explore products such as Kaju Katli, Mysore Pak, Badam Halwa, Gulab Jamun, Adhirasam, Murukku, Ribbon Pakoda, and festive gift boxes.

The goal is to show how traditional businesses can use modern AI tools without losing their original identity.

Why This Matters for Small Businesses

You don't need to own a large company to start building an online presence.

Whether you run a homemade food business, bakery, clothing boutique, gift shop, handicraft store, or neighborhood retail business, an online storefront can help customers discover your products and understand what you offer.

AI tools can assist with branding, website development, product descriptions, and visual design.

However, business owners should verify product details, pricing, generated images, checkout functionality, and customer information before launching.

AI Freelancing Opportunity

If you're learning AI website development, this project can also serve as a practical portfolio example.

You can explore offering services such as:

• Small business website development

• E-commerce store setup

• AI-assisted product photography

• Digital product catalog creation

• Website redesign and online branding

• Website deployment and maintenance

The key is to build useful solutions, demonstrate your skills, and deliver reliable results to real clients.

videos.title: How To Build The Future: Paul Graham & Amjad Masad
videos.description:
Replit was building toward the AI coding era years before it had a name. In 2024, the company shipped an agent that could take a request in plain English, work through errors, provision its own infrastructure, and keep going until the software actually worked. The model companies even reached out to ask how Replit had pulled it off.

Co-founder and CEO Amjad Masad had been thinking about making programming radically more accessible since 2008, and Replit’s original pitch deck predicted AI-generated code before the Transformer paper was published. Today, that same technology is moving into banks, manufacturers, and other large companies, where Amjad says teams are replacing software projects once scoped at $10 million with $250,000 of Replit.

On How to Build the Future, Paul Graham sits down with Amjad to talk about why Replit was so well positioned when coding agents arrived, what comes after vibe coding, and his bigger vision for the “self-driving company,” where AI agents increasingly build and operate the software a company needs.

videos.title: Priyanka Chopra Jonas Opens Up About Her Daughter's Birth at 27 Weeks
videos.description:
Holding on tight to everything made Priyanka Chopra Jonas successful. It also wore her out.

In this episode, Priyanka Chopra Jonas and Jay Shetty talk about the day she stopped running. She moved fast for a really long time. She used to feel guilty for taking even one day off. Now she loves being the one who picks her daughter up from school.

Priyanka shares the two questions she asks when her mind starts to spiral. She tells the story of the argument with Nick that changed how they talk. And she opens up about the 110 days after her daughter was born at 27 weeks.

Learn why she says thoughts are not facts. And learn what her daughter told her doll that almost made her cancel a flight.
